svg.aria-label: Anubis Guardian's two modes on a stylized two-panel interface. Mode 1, codebase audit: secrets and git history, config/CI/infrastructure, credentials in configuration, npm dependency audit, JS/TS SAST/taint/authorization, optional framework playbooks, SARIF/JSON/HTML with a coverage manifest. Mode 2, URL audit: deployed sites you own, consent-gated — L1 passive, L2 discovery, L3 probe with verified ownership (DNS TXT or .well-known file); the gate is enforced. Bottom chips: 49/49 honeypot self-test, 0 false positives on the clean corpus, 17/17 labelled corpus, 20/20 multilingual corpus, 3/3 gitleaks matched.
svg.text: the gate is enforced, not promised.
